announcements.headline: Publication of Programme Admission Particulars
announcements.insight: This announcement signals a capital raising initiative for Hyde Housing, likely to fund development or refinance debt in the context of high interest rates impacting the social housing sector; however, as Hyde is a private entity, there is no direct listed equity impact.

announcements.headline: Hyde Group Annual Report and Financial Statements
announcements.insight: As a private housing association, Hyde Group is not listed on the UK equity markets; this RNS serves as a statutory filing for regulatory compliance rather than a market-moving event for public investors.

announcements.headline: Arhag transfers homes and services to Hyde Group
announcements.insight: This is an internal restructuring within the Hyde Group rather than a market-moving event for listed entities; it reflects ongoing consolidation in the social housing sector but carries no direct equity implication for public markets.
